summary: Implemented the remaining methods in my five prober/CLI files: MultiByteCharSetProber (reset, feed, get_confidence, charset_name/language), EUCJPProber (reset, feed, get_confidence, charset_name/language), JOHABProber (charset_name/language), SingleByteCharSetProber (reset, feed, get_confidence, charset_name/language), and cli/chardetect.py (description_of, main); I checked them by driving the probers directly on the EUC-JP, Johab and windows-1251 samples (all detected). The last full-suite run I saw was 34 passed and 342 failed, with the failures coming from other builders' still-stubbed prober files (big5, cp949, euckr, gb2312, sjis, mbcsgroup, sbcsgroup, hebrew) that lack charset_name and so trigger NotImplementedError in the MB group prober.
